children: Bunzl's share buyback plan and outlook should reassure investors, Peel Hunt's Andrew Nussey writes in a note. The U.K. distribution and services group raised its full-year guidance and launched a new 500 million-pound buyback program. The company seems to handle volatile market conditions well, he says. Shares are down 0.9% at 27.66 pounds. (najat.kantouar@wsj.com)
